config._doc: Bounded SmolVLA training screen, declared BEFORE any training run. Not a convergence study, not a closed-loop evaluation.
config.pretrained: lerobot/smolvla_base (local HF cache, pinned snapshot recorded in results)
config.trainable: action expert + state projection (freeze_vision_encoder=True, train_expert_only=True: smolvla_base defaults)
config.image_augmentation: none (lerobot default), identical for all arms

heldout_eval.never_seen: no held-out episode or synthetic descendant enters training; state fingerprints checked

metrics: phase-balanced normalised arm-action MAE over the 50-step chunk (phases: approach, carry, handover, retreat from the held-out episode's gripper commands)
skill vs persistence baseline (1 - MAE_policy / MAE_hold-current-state)
gripper closed-state precision/recall over chunk steps 0-10 and transition timing error

decision_rule.augmentation_helps: arm mean phase-balanced error >= 10% below R (mean over seeds) AND gripper transition timing error not worse than R by > 1 frame
decision_rule.contact_helps: R+C satisfies augmentation_helps AND is >= 10% below R+G+
decision_rule.otherwise: report as no demonstrated benefit; do not scale
